name: The Corrupter
summary: A piece of flayed demon skin, taken from the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress, smells rotten yet is surprisingly pliable. Red markings of some language cover one side, and at the bottom is a clear symbol that looks like a signature. Maurin Bonesplitter at Ghost Walker Post may be able to tell you more.

sections.title: A Strip of Skin
sections.body: The torn skin stinks of rot, yet it bends easily, though it seems dry and fragile. Unrolled, it carries red markings on one side, a written language of some sort. At the bottom is a plain symbol, which you take to be a signature.

sections.title: Maurin's View
sections.body: Maurin Bonesplitter at Ghost Walker Post may know more about the skin. Maurin holds that the Burning Blade are coming to see how weak they are, with poor magic and little strength. Whatever power they have comes from those they serve, not from any grasp of true power and knowledge.

sections.title: What the Markings Mean
sections.body: Maurin recognises the runes as an old language, somewhat like Eredun but very different in the details. If Maurin is right, the skin is a contract of some kind, and the symbol at the bottom is the signature of a demon, Lord Azrethoc.

faq.q: What is written on the flayed skin?
faq.answer: Red markings, a written language of some sort, cover one side. At the bottom is a clear symbol that looks like a signature. Maurin Bonesplitter at Ghost Walker Post may know more.

faq.q: Where does the skin come from?
faq.answer: It is taken from the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace.
Maurin Bonesplitter is at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace, and that is where the skin is brought.

faq.q: What does Maurin think of the Burning Blade?
faq.answer: Maurin sees them as weak, with poor magic and little strength. In that view, whatever power they have comes from those they serve.
